Trace, implement and test: leetcode34 find first and last position of element in sorted array binary search

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> searchRange(vector<int>& nums, int target) {
        vector<int> res(2, -1);
        if (nums.empty()) return res; /* 处理输入: nums = {} */
        
        const int len = nums.size();
        int left = 0, right = len - 1;
        while (left < right)
        {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (nums[mid] < target)
                left = mid + 1;
            else right = mid;
        }
        if (nums[right] != target)
            return res;
        
        res[0] = right;
        left = right, right = nums.size();

        while (left < right)
        {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (nums[mid] <= target)
                left = mid + 1;
            else right = mid;
        }
        res[1] = left - 1;

        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {5, 7, 7, 8, 8, 10};
    int target = 8;
    auto res = sol.searchRange(nums, target);
    for (auto &pos : res)
        cout << pos << " ";    

    return 0;
}
